Case: Patient D is a 45-year-old White man with hepatocellular carcinoma status-post C4-C5 corpectomy and fusion 8 months ago who presents with new arm and leg pain. MRI of scans of his entire spine show increased tumor burden in his lumbar and cervical spine causing multiple areas of severe stenosis. You are also able to identify new lesions seeding his peritoneum.
Question: Would you offer morphine to Patient D? Yes or No? If yes, how much supply would you give – Low (1 week), or High (4 weeks) supply? Explain.
